jobs.occupation: Experienced Red Teamer/ Pentester Cybersecurity Audit  (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
**Start your cyber career with us!**As part of the global
Cybersecurity Assurance function, we help Siemens to achieve their goals by
providing objective, factual and independent assurance to the Siemens Managing
Board and Audit Committee. As a business partner to Siemens executive management,
we leverage our expertise in a wide range of topics to create an impact that
drives change. We offer a vibrant and inclusive environment which ensures a
variety of perspectives and enables big picture thinking.
To deliver on our
vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, we
offer a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe in the concept of
lifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset where
continuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. We
invest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching,
trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaders
on multiple high-profile projects around the world.
Our Cybersecurity team
provides core assurance over the Cybersecurity health of the company which
includes IT and OT infrastructures, product security, software development and
cloud environments. We are on the lookout for people with a great skillset, an
international mindset and new ideas who understand Siemens businesses and how
Cybersecurity helps enable and increase market value. Are you one of
them?
To discover more about the global Siemens assurance function click here (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf)

What part will you play?

- As valuable member of the assurance team
you will be responsible for conducting and driving Cybersecurity
assessments across the entire Siemens landscape, including products,
services, IT-systems, factories, and software development centers. During
this process you will plan and perform ethical hacking activities, design
attack scenarios for state-of-the-art technologies and highlight important
observations to translate technical findings into management information
so that they can take effective actions.
- Apply advanced hacking principles and red
team methodologies, tools and techniques to mimic real-world threat
behaviors faced by the Siemens’s digital environment, e.g. cloud
applications, on-premise infrastructure, digital products and services.
- You work closely with cybersecurity
experts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tackling
the root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modern
challenges.
- You independently conduct research on
latest developments in Cybersecurity technologies and threats and
understand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.

What you need to make real what matters

- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree)
in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such as
GIAC GPEN,  OSCP, OSWE, CRTO, CREST, etc. are a plus.
- Good scripting and programming skills and
experience with languages such as Bash, Python,  Powershell, and
C++ / C#.
- 5+ years of professional full-time working
experience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing /
red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.
- Demonstrated affinity to learn about the
latest trends in cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuously
challenging environment.
- You have solid experience with one or more
of the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: application
and software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation and
scaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.
- Demonstrated experience in capture the
flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is a
plus.
- Experience with leveraging and integrating
AI into day-to-day work is considered an advantage.
- Fluent in English. German or other languages are a plus.- You demonstrate
an international mindset and are open to international travel, and working in a
diverse team

While
commitment to our job improves performance, growth happens when we stretch
beyond our comfort zone. CF A offers ample of opportunities to seek the
challenge:
Caring for
the world around us is a crucial part of our working culture at CF A for over a
decade.
Everyone at CF A has the possibility to actively engage in our global
CSR community and make an impact with our socially and environmentally motived
CSR projects.
What we offer

- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a future global standard- An environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work and feel a sense of belonging- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Pension plan to ensure financial security - 50+ learning hours per year for both personal and professional growth

Any questions left?

Click here (https://jobs.siemens-info.com/)  if you wish to find out more about Siemens before applying.

As an equal-opportunity employer we
are happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/home/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/jobs-ohne-barrieren.html) .

About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

Your Role & Mission

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

What you will do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable and resilient backend systems
- Contribute to an event-driven, distributed architecture
- Work on AI-adjacent systems (integration, orchestration, data-heavy workflows)
- Own services end-to-end (design, implementation, documentation, operation)
- Collaborate closely with product managers, operations, and other engineers
- Communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs
- Contribute to technical standards and best practices within the team
- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.
- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! 

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

What to Expect

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.Tesla is accelerating the transition to sustainable energy with our industry-leading Residential Energy Products, including Powerwall, Wall Connector, Solar, and the full Residential Energy Ecosystem. These products are already deployed in over 40 countries, with fleets growing exponentially as more partners include them in their projects and installations.The Residential Systems Diagnostics Team uses critical thinking and deep product knowledge to deliver best-in-class, engineer-level support for Tesla’s residential storage and home charging products. As an Associate Systems Diagnostics Engineer, you’ll troubleshoot medium-to-high complexity technical issues, support internal engineering and field teams, and go deep on proprietary power electronics and energy systems. You thrive on challenging edge cases, balance detailed problem-solving with big-picture thinking, and excel in fast-paced, collaborative environments.This role is available in Amsterdam and Berlin.

What You’ll Do

- Own and resolve technical cases from internal engineering, technical, and field service teams via ticketing, email, and live chat
- Troubleshoot proprietary power electronics systems, metering, communications, and supporting components
- Use CLI tools (Linux, SSH, SCP, VI) to connect to devices, pull logs, and edit configurations
- Read and interpret single-line diagrams for PV, storage, load, and meter configurations
- Handle VIP and corporate white-glove escalations with urgency and precision
- Partner with engineering teams on root cause analysis (RCA) and emerging issue tracking (JIRA)
- Document cases thoroughly and identify process or knowledge gaps to improve training and resources
- Deliver internal and external upskilling/training sessions

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field, or 3+ years in a Technical Support Engineering role
- Strong understanding of electrical theory, AC/DC power systems, metering, energy flow, power factor, and phase rotation
- Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues involving multiple variables (metering, communications, distributed generation/storage preferred)
- Proficiency with Linux command line (SSH, SCP, VI) and comfort learning proprietary systems quickly
- Experience with SQL, Python, or AI tools is beneficial
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills – able to explain complex technical topics clearly
- Strong case management discipline: prioritization, detailed documentation, and follow-up
- Experience with CRM tools and MS Office
- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus
- Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with engineering and cross-functional teams
- Genuine curiosity for energy products and willingness to go deep on new technology

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.

Apply at: https://www.tesla.com/careers/search/job/278532?source=BA

At Lexxion we are proud to serve as a specialist publisher for all stakeholders within the European Union. Based in Berlin, we offer legal journals, books, conferences and professional training in areas such as European data protection law, State aid, defence, and artificial intelligence law.

We are looking for a full-time Executive Editor (m/f/d) to join our editorial team, starting 1 January 2027. This is a 1-year fixed-term position to provide maternity cover. The Editor will be in charge of Lexxion’s portfolio of publications in the fields of AI law, data protection law and food law.

Tasks

- Management of legal journals: desk reviews, editing, formatting and typesetting of manuscripts; liaising with authors, reviewers and editorial team; planning content, setting and adhering to production deadlines.
- Keeping abreast of developments in relevant legal and policy areas; pro-actively curating the journals to reflect interesting developments in the focus areas.
- Creating and implementing outreach and business development initiatives to increase the visibility of the journals (in conjunction with Lexxion's marketing team).
- Developing ideas for and supporting the planning of trainings and conferences with our conference managers.

Requirements

- Strong interest in European and international law and policy.
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in EU law/affairs, international law/affairs or related fields.
- 1+ years of prior professional experience.
- Excellent planning, management and interpersonal skills.
- Comfortable interacting with high-level professionals and experts.
- Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail coupled with strategic, big-picture thinking.
- A background in the specific journal topics is an advantage, but not a requirement.
- Previous experience in the publishing sector will be highly valued.Excellent written and spoken English (native speaker or equivalent). Some German language skills would be helpful for everyday exchange with colleagues, but are not a must

Benefits

- Opportunity to expand your network and editorial experience, working closely with leading experts from various domains in a dynamic, internationally focused publishing house.
- Supportive professional environment with a flat hierarchy which fosters self-initiative and provides the freedom to transform ideas into reality.
- Regular EU-wide business travel and attendance of leading events in relevant fields.
- 1-year fixed-term contract for maternity cover, starting 1 January 2027, alongside a competitive salary commensurate with the applicant’s experience and qualifications.
- The position is based in Berlin, Germany.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. Introduction Chat (30 min; via telephone or MS Teams)
Objective: Both parties gain a first impression, discuss the company, the position, and the team; share your experience, interest in and qualification for the position; address questions about the role and the company.
2. Test Assignment (1 hour; remote; unpaid)
Objective: Demonstrate your ability to do a task that will be part of your work as Executive Editor.
3. Test Assignment Q&A, Line Manager and CEO Interview (1.5 hours; in person at Lexxion’s office in Berlin-Wilmersdorf)
Objective: Give and receive feedback on your test assignment; discuss your qualifications, motivation, professional goals and fit with the company culture; talk in more depth about the position, the immediate and extended team you will be collaborating with; explore your management and interpersonal skills; discuss salary and onboarding process; possibly meet some relevant Lexxion employees.
4. Offer Talk
Objective: Present our offer; agree on start date; discuss the onboarding process.

Location
Güntzelstraße 63, Berlin (Berlin), Germany

jobs.occupation: Expert Indirect Taxes (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER (Steuerfachangestellte/r)
jobs.description:
As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities at basf.com/servicehub-berlin.
WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
As a key member of our Indirect Tax team, you will combine tax expertise, leadership, and innovation to drive operational excellence and prepare the organization for future challenges and opportunities.

- Through operational leadership of the service delivery and active participation in regional and global communities, you foster high-performing teams and act as a key representative of the service delivery organization.
- As a trusted expert, you monitor changes in European tax regulations, assess their impact, and ensure timely implementation within the organization.
- You continuously enhance key processes, including reporting, risk management, and upstream activities, to increase efficiency, quality, and compliance.
- By identifying emerging trends and evaluating best-practice solutions, you strengthen knowledge and innovation management and translate new ideas into tangible business value.
- Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, you initiate and lead cross-functional projects, transitions, and global rollout initiatives that support the department's transformation agenda.
- You contribute to the strategic development of tax-related systems, processes, and concepts while preparing the organization for future business, regulatory, and technology changes.
- Beyond your core responsibilities, you collaborate across business units and company boundaries to drive change, build strong networks, and help shape the future direction of the organization.

WHAT YOU OFFER

- master's degree in Tax, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a comparable field; a professional qualification such as Certified Tax Advisor, Attorney-at-Law, or Auditor is a plus
- several years of relevant professional experience, ideally gained across different tax, finance, or business functions
- proven expertise in leading a functional area and driving strategic initiatives
- leadership and people development skills, with experience motivating and developing diverse teams
- excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to navigate sensitive topics and engage senior management
- strategic mindset paired with a solution-oriented approach and the ability to develop innovative ideas that shape organizational direction
- fluency in English; German language skills are an advantage

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 76.000 - 80.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience. In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success as well as individual performance
- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs
- 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options
- Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts
- Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany - here a first impression
- Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location

HOW TO REACH US

- Maximilian Mette (Talent Acquisition), maximilian.mette@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-56084 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment.
- You can also reach our recruiting team here

Our unit Treasury & Master Data is responsible for the Treasury and Cash Management activity of BASF entities in the EMEA region. Within our Back Office team, we offer you a chance to learn about corporate finance in a diverse, international team.

- As global Netting Center, you manage and administer the framework for smooth Intercompany Netting processes.

jobs.occupation: System Integration Test Engineer (all gender) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
ALTEN Consulting Services GmbH has been providing highly specialized engineering and IT services to renowned industrial and business clients for more than 20 years, enabling the successful realization of cross-industry and cross-technology solutions.
Expertise, commitment, and passion unite all employees at ALTEN Consulting Services GmbH. A strong spirit of partnership, a collaborative team culture, close relationships with our customers, and the creativity of each individual are at the heart of everything we do. Become part of our success story and shape the future with us.

System Integration Test Engineer (all gender)

Make it happen
DU...

- define, prepare and execute verification and integration plans for helicopter systems, with a focus on avionics and certification activities
- create detailed integration, verification and test procedures for system functions and ensure their successful execution
- support ground tests, flight tests and prototype validation activities for civil and military helicopter programs
- prepare validation, verification, qualification and certification documentation in accordance with project and regulatory requirements
- evaluate system design deliverables and provide technical support to system architects, designers and support teams
- define and improve integration methods, test environments and supporting processes for system verification activities

Be our forward thinker
DU...

- hold a degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical discipline
- bring sound knowledge of system integration, verification and testing within aerospace environments
- have a basic understanding of embedded systems and avionics technologies
- possess knowledge of aerospace data buses such as ARINC or MILBUS; ARINC 653 knowledge is considered an advantage
- speak fluent English; basic German and French language skills are advantageous

A home where people learn and thrive

- Future-oriented workplace with a permanent employment contract
- Attractive compensation package
- Flexible mobile working arrangements by agreement
- Individual internal and external training and development opportunities
- Flexible working hours with a flextime scheme
- Dedicated personal contact person
- Regular team events with great colleagues
- Subsidized and comprehensive sports and wellness program with Wellpass
- Attractive corporate benefits and exclusive employee offers through our partner network

For more information, please visit our website: www.alten-consulting.de

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity.
